rule_analysis: Frozen target-specific Proposed Top-5 local monitors
estimand_unit: Known-fault, target-specific local monitor. Cross-fault primary summaries use the 17 reserved faults: macro mean local-monitor normal run FAR, run detection, threshold occupancy, and all-run penalized delay.
data_calibration: Family, Top-5 coordinates, orientation, scaler, CUSUM k, and local limit frozen before reserved-final access; local calibration uses normal validation.
key_marker: Macro local FAR 4.376% (95% CI 3.106-5.765%); 4,250/4,250 final runs detected.
deployment_meaning: Primary evidence for one fault-conditioned local monitor at a time. Not a plant-level detector bank and not a fault classifier.

estimand_unit: Internal benchmark analyses of construction complexity and selection stability: branch-level operating endpoints, family recovery, exact Top-5 recovery, Jaccard overlap, and orientation agreement.
data_calibration: Performed after the primary freeze. U2 uses deterministic internal development/evaluation re-splits of the same TEP benchmark; repeat states do not replace the Step-22-R primary states.
key_marker: U2 Adaptive-5: family recovery 96.47%; exact Top-5 recovery 62.35%; mean Jaccard 0.857. U1 showed no broad panel-level superiority of Adaptive-5 over simpler AD-based rules.
deployment_meaning: Quantifies simplification and state uncertainty. Not a new deployed operating rule, external validation, or proof that one sparse coordinate set is uniquely correct.

estimand_unit: Stress tests on frozen standardized residual-evidence coordinates: one-/two-/three-coordinate loss and matched contamination geometry.
data_calibration: Frozen denominator, coordinate state, CUSUM k, and threshold retained. Perturbation unit is a standardized residual-evidence coordinate.
key_marker: Every one- and two-coordinate loss combination retained complete run detection; three-coordinate loss degraded performance. Common-mode contamination substantially reduced the dispersed-noise FAR advantage.
deployment_meaning: Supports bounded residual-evidence redundancy only. Not physical sensor-failure/noise robustness, raw-input robustness, or prospective deployment validation.

estimand_unit: System-level OR of all 17 frozen local monitor alarms. Normal FAR is a plant/bank-style OR-rule estimand; real-fault non-target alarms are cross-triggers, not false alarms.
data_calibration: No new system-level calibration; directly ORs the already frozen local monitors.
key_marker: System-level normal run FAR 38.0%; complete reserved-fault bank detection. Extensive cross-triggering demonstrates poor selectivity.
deployment_meaning: Hypothetical deployment/selectivity audit showing that coverage alone is insufficient. Not the primary detector and not a validated diagnosis/classification rule.

estimand_unit: System-level gate on G(t)=max_j C_j(t)/h_j. FAR is the joint-gate normal-evaluation run-level FAR; gate-time target rank is descriptive attribution only.
data_calibration: Post-freeze; single gate threshold calibrated only on normal validation using the empirical 95th percentile of run maxima. Normal evaluation and reserved-final fault data were not used for gate calibration.
key_marker: Normal-evaluation FAR 3.20% (95% CI 1.39-6.21%); 250/250 detected for every reserved fault; later alarms than the OR bank.
deployment_meaning: Promising exploratory arbitration layer. Not prospectively confirmed, independently validated, the unchanged Step-22 method, or a fault classifier.

rule_analysis: U4 protocol-matched dynamic CVA residual baselines
estimand_unit: Comparator-level macro FAR, 15/30/60/120-min and full-horizon run detection, threshold occupancy, and all-run penalized delay for CVA-RR Q/L1 under the common TEP data-role protocol.
data_calibration: Independent post-freeze protocol-matched implementation. Proposed Step-22-R states remain frozen; U4 does not retune or replace them.
key_marker: CVA-RR Q/L1 were faster at 15-60 min; Proposed had stronger 120-min/full coverage, sustained occupancy, and tail-sensitive delay. Holm-significant dynamic contrasts: 0/16.
deployment_meaning: Defines a dynamic comparator operating region. Not an exact reproduction of one published codebase, an exhaustive state-of-the-art ranking, or evidence of universal dominance.
